Message:
drm/panel: simple: Add Chefree CH101OLHLWH-002 panel

Add support for the Chefree CH101OLHLWH-002 10.1" (1280x800)
color TFT LCD panel, connected over LVDS.

Timings are taken from the datasheet version P0.5.
